name: Tuskira AI Agent Gateway
summary: Open-source, self-hosted gateway in front of MCP tool servers and LLM APIs: authenticates every call, injects credentials, scopes tools per agent profile and logs it all.
description: One Go binary with three planes: MCP (:8080), REST API and admin console (:8081) and an LLM proxy (:8082) for Claude (direct or via AWS Bedrock), OpenAI and Gemini with your own keys. It authenticates each request, injects per-request credentials, scopes tools per agent profile and records every MCP tool call and LLM request; the console includes a catalog of ready-made MCP servers, LLM logs and (with the optional ClickHouse analytics profile) access logs and session timelines. Needs PostgreSQL; ships Docker Compose and Kubernetes manifests. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex CLI and any MCP or provider-SDK client. Pre-1.0 alpha (v0.6.1 on 2026-10-22); macOS and Linux, Windows via WSL2 untested. No Tuskira account needed. Note: the demo stack stores request/response bodies unless you turn capture off.

agent_access.notes: Agents connect to the gateway's MCP plane (:8080) and LLM plane (:8082) with gateway-issued API keys; bootstrap-key creates the first admin key.
